# Departments

Manage departments in Teamleader Focus.

```php
Teamleader::departments()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\General\Departments` |
| Create / update / delete | — / — / — |
| Pagination | No |

## Endpoints

- `departments.info`
- `departments.list`

## Filters

Passed as the first argument to `list()`. Any other key throws.

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| `ids` | Array of department UUIDs to filter by |
| `status` | Filter by department status (active, archived) |

## Sorting

Pass `sort` (and optionally `sort_order`) in the options. Any other field throws.

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `created_at` | Creation date |
| `default_department` | Ascending lists the default department first |
| `name` | Department name |

## Accepted values

Public constants on the class. Body fields and enum values outside these lists
throw before the request is sent.

| Constant | Values |
|---|---|
| `STATUSES` | `active`, `archived` |

## Methods

### `list()`

```php
list(array $filters = [], array $options = []): array
```

List departments

- `$filters` — ids, status (active and/or archived)
- `$options` — sort (default_department|name|created_at), sort_order

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` On an unknown filter key, option, value or sort field

### `info()`

```php
info($id, $includes = null): array
```

Get one department

- `$id` — Department UUID
- `$includes` — departments.info takes no includes; passing any throws

### `active()`

```php
active(): array
```

Get active departments only

### `archived()`

```php
archived(): array
```

Get archived departments only

### `byIds()`

```php
byIds(array $ids): array
```

Get departments by specific IDs

- `$ids` — Array of department UUIDs

### `getAvailableStatuses()`

```php
getAvailableStatuses(): array
```

Get available status values for filtering

## Examples

Get all departments:

```php
$departments = Teamleader::departments()->list();
```

Get only active departments:

```php
$departments = Teamleader::departments()->list(['status' => ['active']]);
```

Get specific departments by ID:

```php
$departments = Teamleader::departments()->list(['ids' => ['uuid1', 'uuid2']]);
```

Get departments sorted by name:

```php
$departments = Teamleader::departments()->list([], ['sort' => [['field' => 'name', 'order' => 'asc']]]);
```

Get a single department:

```php
$department = Teamleader::departments()->info('department-uuid-here');
```
